text_block_list.text:
The three years with Ikuno Dictus came to 
a close, and after a brief passage of 
time—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—From these perspectives, we believe it 
would be effective to provide self-care 
learning opportunities for the Umamusume 
as well during overseas expeditions.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Improving the accuracy of your 
self-analysis, in particular, will become 
a key factor in raising the precision of 
whatever actions you take on-site after 
traveling abroad.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you came up with this 
workshop plan. I see...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, establishing a solid foundation 
through standardized learning 
opportunities not just for trainers and 
management, but for the athletes as well, 
might be crucial—"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, truly impressive. I've learned 
so much from what you've shared today— 
every bit of it will be of great 
reference!

...Ikuno Dictus and I received high praise 
for the management techniques that allowed 
her to race safely for three full years—

As a result, I ended up taking a 
consultation from Mei Satake, a URA staff 
member from the Tracen Academy Enhancement 
Division standing right in front of me.

Apparently, she is in charge of a team 
that supports Japanese Umamusume on 
overseas expeditions—

They said they actively wanted to utilize 
Ikuno Dictus's and my management 
techniques for future overseas 
expeditions.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, I heard some truly great stories 
today! Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're all alright with it, we 
would love for you to keep cooperating 
with us moving forward."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
There are still many challenges with 
overseas expeditions. I want to make 
improvements so the Umamusume can travel 
safely and achieve great results.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I'll do, I'll lend you as much help as 
you need.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see! You two really are the great 
duo the rumors say you are...!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because of who you two are 
that you were able to leave behind such a 
wonderful three-year trail of hoofprints—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Keep doing your best, both of you. I'll 
be cheering you on personally.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

Afterward, once the meeting with Mei 
Satake concluded—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...It really is a wonderful feeling.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To think that our journey could help 
someone in so many different ways...
choice_data_list:
I'm sure it'll stay that way from now on, 
too.

text_block_list.text:
The hoofprints of Ikuno Dictus's path had 
indeed reached a milestone after three 
years.
Yet this was merely the beginning.

She will continue to run for a long time 
to come... and leave her mark on the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then— Will you bear witness to it 
with me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: As my Trainer.

As long as Ikuno Dictus wishes to run, I 
will continue to be her Trainer.
That vow will never change—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to working with you from 
here on out, Trainer-san."
